kurals.tr: Itukkan Varungaal Nakuka Adhanai / Atuththoorvadhu Aqdhoppa Thil
kurals.m: If troubles come, laugh; there is nothing like that, to press upon and drive away sorrow

kurals.tr: Vellath Thanaiya Itumpai Arivutaiyaan / Ullaththin Ullak Ketum
kurals.m: A flood of troubles will be overcome by the (courageous) thought which the minds of the wise will entertain, even in sorrow

kurals.tr: Itumpaikku Itumpai Patuppar Itumpaikku / Itumpai Pataaa Thavar
kurals.m: They give sorrow to sorrow, who in sorrow do not suffer sorrow

kurals.tr: Matuththavaa Yellaam Pakatannaan Utra / Itukkan Itarppaatu Utaiththu
kurals.m: Troubles will vanish (i.e., will be troubled) before the man who (struggles against difficulties) as a

kurals.tr: Atukki Varinum Azhivilaan Utra / Itukkan Itukkat Patum
kurals.m: The troubles of that man will be troubled (and disappear) who, however thickly they may come upon him, does not abandon (his purpose)

kurals.tr: Atremendru Allar Patupavo Petremendru / Ompudhal Thetraa Thavar
kurals.m: Will those men ever cry out in sorrow, "we are destitute" who, (in their prosperity), give not way to (undue desire) to keep their wealth

kurals.tr: Ilakkam Utampitumpaik Kendru Kalakkaththaik / Kaiyaaraak Kollaadhaam Mel
kurals.m: The great will not regard trouble as trouble, knowing that the body is the butt of trouble

kurals.tr: Inpam Vizhaiyaan Itumpai Iyalpenpaan / Thunpam Urudhal Ilan
kurals.m: That man never experiences sorrow, who does not seek for pleasure, and who considers distress to be natural (to man)

kurals.tr: Inpaththul Inpam Vizhaiyaadhaan Thunpaththul / Thunpam Urudhal Ilan
kurals.m: He does not suffer sorrow, in sorrow who does not look for pleasure in pleasure

kurals.tr: Innaamai Inpam Enakkolin Aakundhan / Onnaar Vizhaiyunj Chirappu
kurals.m: The elevation, which even his enemies will esteem, will be gained by him, who regards pain as pleasure
